class.name: IfcPoint
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-42:1992 : A point is a location in some real Cartesian coordinate space R m , for m = 1, 2 or 3. NOTE: Corresponding ISO 10303 entity: point. Only the subtypes cartesian_point, point_on_curve, point_on_surface have been incorporated in the current release of IFC.
